title: Quality O' Life
description: Some technical changes to improve the minecraft experience.
body:
![⠀](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a831c6a6c5b93dba02f075648b6a8f752bbda852.webp)
Vanilla QOL is a lightweight quality-of-life addon designed to improve your Minecraft experience while keeping the game feeling fully vanilla. No complicated mechanics, no feature overload, just smart improvements that make everyday gameplay smoother, faster, and more convenient. Perfect for players who love vanilla Minecraft but want a few extra comforts. ![⠀](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/671e8d295afa54a12627802b0df964ef42ca0753.png) ## Features - **Bone Meal on Sugar Cane** Use bone meal directly on sugar cane to grow it instantly. - **Armor Stands from Dispensers** Dispensers can place armor stands automatically. - **Boats from Dispensers** Dispensers can deploy boats, making transport systems easier to automate. - **Crop Planting with Dispensers** Dispensers can plant crops automatically for more efficient farming. - **Faster Happy Ghasts** Happy Ghasts now move faster for smoother travel and better usability. - **Invisible Item Frames** Craft invisible item frames using a custom recipe for cleaner builds and decoration. - **Concrete Powder Hardening in Water** Dropped concrete powder turns into solid concrete when it touches water. - **Better Stonecutter** - **Recipe string x4** to wool block - **Stained glass** to **glass block** into crafting table ## Philosophy Vanilla QOL focuses on one simple goal: Make Minecraft less tedious without changing what makes it feel like Minecraft. Everything is designed to feel natural, balanced, and true to vanilla gameplay. # Website If you have any questions, need assistance, or simply want to share your thoughts or feedback, feel free to reach out. We're always here to help and would love to hear from you – whether you're looking for answers, suggestions, or just want to let us know how we're doing.
